evidence.field: file description; direct original link; licensing
evidence.text: The inspected page identifies 菜-seal.svg as a digitally created vector depicting 菜 in Shuowen seal-script style, names Chinese character databases as available sources, and states that the image is public domain, with attribution appreciated but not required. Its linked original-file URL resolves to https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f8/%E8%8F%9C-seal.svg?utm_campaign=index&utm_content=original&utm_source=commons.wikimedia.org. The image is a modern redraw, not an ancient artifact photograph. The direct image fetch failed with a cache miss, but the description and rights page were accessible.
evidence.title: File:菜-seal.svg - Wikimedia Commons

evidence.field: 字形 inventory; form history; graphic analysis
evidence.text: The opened entry displays a seal-script form, six bronze examples, and one slip-text example; it gives no oracle-bone form in the displayed inventory. Its account analyzes 菜 as 艸 plus phonetic 采, says bronze examples use it as a place name, and reports Qin-slip 采(菜)羹. The individual bronze and seal image links failed to fetch, so specimen pixels and dating were not inspected.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 — 菜

search_audit.outcome: Search located the Commons file page. Opened and inspected its direct-original link and licensing details.

search_audit.outcome: Opened the Commons file page and CUHK entry. Tried the actual linked original SVG and CUHK seal/bronze specimen image links; the web tool returned cache-miss access failures.

search_audit.query: Open direct file link from Commons page and historical specimen links shown on CUHK entry
search_audit.outcome: Inspected the source-page link targets; all three fetch attempts failed with cache miss. Retained only the candidate whose identity and reuse terms are established by its accessible description page.

gaps: Only one candidate with accessible identity and reuse provenance was established. Its direct image fetch failed, so the harness may be unable to acquire it despite the verified source-page link and public-domain statement.
The Commons page's linked original URL differs from the URL in the prior acquisition packet. The verified direct target is the f/f8 path shown on the inspected page; no hash directory was guessed.

CUHK displayed historical-form categories and image links, but its individual seal and bronze image targets failed to load. No separate bronze or Qin-slip image candidate with verified direct URL and reuse rights could be established.
No image pixels were inspected. The proposed glyph below is based on its source-page description and awaits the harness's acquisition and visual review.

items.caption: A modern vector redraw presents 菜 in Shuowen seal-script style. The historical dictionary parses the graph as 艸 with 采 supplying the sound.
items.alt: Modern vector redraw of 菜 in the Shuowen seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: The accessible Commons page identifies the character and script style and explicitly states public-domain reuse terms. This is the only candidate with established identity and rights in the inspected pages. It can illustrate a seal-style form, while its modern redraw status is made explicit.
items.rights: Public domain according to the Commons description page; attribution appreciated but not required.

limitations.text: The Commons-linked direct SVG URL was verified from the file page but could not be fetched by the web tool due to a cache miss; no pixels were inspected. CUHK specimen image links also failed, so no distinct bronze or slip glyph with individual provenance and reuse terms is proposed.
